summary: Unit tests thoroughly cover core matrix logic (cartesian product, excludes, includes, validation, CLI) with good edge cases. Workflow structure tests validate YAML shape and actionlint compliance. However, test suite critically violates explicit task requirement: 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT...Do NOT test your script directly—all testing goes through the pipeline.' Provided tests are direct Python unit tests only. Missing required integration test harness that should: (1) set up temp git repos with fixture data, (2) run `act push --rm`, (3) capture output to `act-result.txt`, (4) assert exact expected values. Task explicitly requires `act-result.txt` as mandatory artifact—this is never generated. Test suite lacks E2E validation of actual workflow execution.
